fields.value: Support framework-agnostic resume callbacks alongside save(export=...)

run.save(export=...) in src/etude/train/tracking.py and src/etude/train/state.py already lets non-PyTorch backends (such as MLX) write framework-neutral state files into Etude atomic save folders without importing torch. However, run.resume(extra=...) has no symmetric load/restore callback and returns extra instead of the committed save folder Path when extra is provided, forcing callers that combine extra counts with custom framework files to import internal etude.train.state.read_state and look up the state folder directly.

Design and add a clean, public, framework-agnostic resume path symmetric with run.save(export=...) (e.g. an optional restore/load callback on run.resume or equivalent idiomatic Etude API) so callers using extra and/or named namespaces can restore custom state files from the committed save folder without importing torch or internal etude.train.state helpers. Preserve full backwards compatibility with run.resume(**objects), run.resume() -> Path | None, and run.resume(extra=T) -> T. Verify seed/manifest validation, named namespaces, clean error behavior, and zero torch imports with tests, and update docs/docstrings.
